title: Tableau Cloud Weekly Active User Trend
dataSources: Tableau Cloud Activity Log (`tableau:cloud:activity`) and Admin Insights.
app: Tableau Cloud Activity Log and Admin Insights exports plus the Tableau Cloud REST API via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=tableau:cloud:activity
| timechart span=1w dc(user) as active_users
| eventstats avg(active_users) as avg_users
| eval below_trend=if(active_users<avg_users*0.85,1,0)
description: Trends the number of distinct weekly active users of Tableau Cloud and flags weeks where engagement drops below trend, an early signal of eroding adoption or an access problem.
value: Adoption is the return on a BI investment; a declining active-user trend for Tableau Cloud surfaces churn before a renewal or rationalisation review.
implementation: Ingest Tableau Cloud usage/activity events; schedule weekly and review adoption dips with the platform owner.
visualization: Timechart of Tableau Cloud weekly active users with trend band.
grandmaExplanation: We track how many people actually use Tableau Cloud each week so a drop in usage is noticed early.
